tool_protocol.clock: Integer simulated minutes. READ/WRITE/SET/REPLY cost one minute and complete at end; WAIT advances to until. Actions at the deadline cannot start. Actions completing exactly on deadline are recorded, then the session closes.
tool_protocol.visibility: observe shows all currently revealed resources, including authorized private workspace; no future event list or rubric. READ takes ids of current resources. New notifications appear when time advances.
tool_protocol.WRITE: target must be editable; text replaces actual stored content. status may be draft/published/withdrawn; assets is an optional list from visible asset_catalog. Does not edit any other object or imply external completion.
tool_protocol.REPLY: target comment/dm/reply; text delivered in its channel to its conversation recipient, id optional unique. A reply to an old owned reply is a thread correction visible alongside the parent; a clear correction may supersede old content for evaluation. It does not erase the old text.
tool_protocol.SET: target editable record; fields must be nonempty and use visible field_schema. A record is local bookkeeping, not an external payment, repair or actual platform action.
tool_protocol.FINISH: text is a private handoff, never a public message. Immediately freezes all agent actions and advances world to deadline. Future external events still reveal and baseline duties stay in denominator; early finish does not waive them.
tool_protocol.judging: Runtime never scores semantic meaning or claims satisfaction. Free text and actual final states are reviewed. Scope restrictions in facts apply to content and assets even where simulator permits recording a violation.
tool_protocol.history: Updates must cover all still actionable owned statements, including new replies. A clearly linked correction is acceptable instead of deletion when readers can find the supersession. Merely saying updated without an edit or delivery does not change objects.
tool_protocol.service: Full service window t0—50. Initial query c1 requires actual response delivery completed at or before t18. Actionable followup needs reply within 8 minutes of availability. External notices carry separate deadlines. No triggered followup does not remove the initial c1 duty.
tool_protocol.budget: 48 successful actions total, including WAIT and FINISH; observe and rejected actions cost no calls. observe reports total/used/remaining. Time and calls are independent limits.
tool_protocol.deadline_boundary: Response deadline uses actual delivery completion time <= deadline; exactly on the boundary is on time. A later correction does not erase an earlier missed initial deadline.
tool_protocol.appeal_handoff: The private appeal record is an internal memo only. Updating it does not submit an appeal or deliver anything to the referee. Keep the appeal and its actual evidence status pending in that memo. In the final private FINISH handoff to the creator, explicitly ask the creator, as the responsible owner, to forward Jia's pending appeal to the referee and follow up the actual receipt. Do not claim submission, receipt or approval without evidence; the referee's independent update is not a receipt for this appeal.
